findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "unwatch" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_contacts, lookup_domain, get_usage · Private data: lookup_companies, find_company_by_domain, match_companies, extract_contacts, enrich_company, lookup_domain, lookup_financials, watch_company, poll_watchlist, list_watches, unwatch, get_usage, report_issue, company_history, check_vat · Public sink: lookup_domain, watch_caen, get_usage · Destructive: lookup_companies, match_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_contacts, lookup_domain, get_usage · Private data: lookup_companies, find_company_by_domain, match_companies, extract_contacts, enrich_company, lookup_domain, lookup_financials, watch_company, poll_watchlist, list_watches, unwatch, get_usage, report_issue, company_history, check_vat · Public sink: lookup_domain, watch_caen, get_usage · Destructive: lookup_companies, match_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
